string-array.name: changelog_v20
string-array.item: Search finds apps by pinyin — initials and full spelling — with the match highlighted.
App tags group apps across the alphabet: sections on top, three letters in the strip, multi-select tagging with existing tags offered.
The Frequent tag follows usage on its own and can be switched off, taking its tags back; a hand-applied Frequent is refused.
A per-app lock asks for the screen lock, with a lock badge on the name; unlocking lifts a pause where the system allows.
The long-press menu gains uninstall; hiding an app asks first; paused apps grey out live.
Favorites reach the bottom edge like the app list and scroll fully into view, with room to spare.
Scrubbing past Z stays at Z; overscrolling the list bottom springs back instead of closing it.
The strip rests in the lower half (full height sideways); the palette picker is a five-column grid of flat Material colors.
Settings back navigation returns to the section it came from, system Back included; settings search finds every row.
Widgets refresh the moment their app freezes and unfreezes, and a frozen widget is never cleaned away.
Night dark theme, wallpaper blur, pinch-to-resize icons, reduced motion.
Backups now cover every setting including the language; private-space keys stay out of them.
About leads with the app name — tapping it opens the project page; the changelog follows the language.

string-array.name: changelog_v19
string-array.item: Language can now be chosen in settings — 10 languages plus Traditional Chinese.
The A-Z strip sits on the side the app list is not aligned to, and the launcher keeps you where you were when the language changes.
Home screen content no longer sits under the status bar when it is shown.
Set as default: a card on the home screen offers to make Deluge your home app, and can be dismissed for good.

string-array.name: changelog_first
string-array.item: Renamed and rebranded as Deluge Launcher, with a new blue theme and icon.
App list: runs edge to edge, and the strip lights up every letter on screen while scrolling.
Fixed scrolling — the list no longer refuses to scroll when a swipe starts at an angle.
Fixed the home screen being slow or blank for a couple of seconds when returning from another app.
Faster cold start: app icons are cached on disk.
Folder rows show how many apps they hold, and whether they are open.
Widgets: height follows the widget itself unless it is set by hand, and dead ones left over from a backup are cleaned up.
Swipe for shortcuts only fires on a sideways swipe, so scrolling past a row is never stolen.
Dropped the navigation library in favour of the launcher\'s own.
